idea-plugin.name: Spring Cloud Port Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Lists every module of a Spring Cloud / Spring Boot multi-module project together with the server.port and context path parsed from its application/bootstrap configuration, in a dedicated side tool window.
以列表形式展示 Spring Cloud 多模块项目中每个子模块的端口（server.port）与 context-path： 支持多 Profile、端口冲突高亮、双击打开配置文件、一键浏览器访问 localhost。
